data_class_evidence.NOT_present_rationale: Supervisor is an internal infrastructure plane. No user health data, payment card data, children data, or PIPA-class personal information flows through inbox/outbox or settings rendering per plan review.

audit_chain_emission_required_rationale: Multiple evidence_required=true capabilities registered: foundry.supervisor.spawn, foundry.supervisor.commit, foundry.supervisor.dead_letter, foundry.supervisor.degrade_account, foundry.supervisor.rotate_window, foundry.supervisor.quarantine (v4 §B.8). All 6 have evidence_required=true per capability seed table. State mutations to provider account state (degrade), tenant ceiling (rotate_window), and billing records (spend/commit) must be auditable per ADR-0069 active-artifact-contract.

spawn_commit.evidence: C.8: `every spawn/commit emits EvidenceRef linked to capability_id`. audit_chain.rs test declared at v4 §A.5 + §B.12 unit #35.

cost_ceiling_usage_blocked.evidence: v4 §B.4 step 13.5 explicitly: `emit_audit_event("UsageBlocked", &ticket)` before dead_letter call.

degrade_account_on_over_usage.evidence: v4 §B.4 steps 8-9: `acc.degrade("over usage limit")` and `acc.degrade("reserve breached")` → RETURN DemoteAndRetry. No `emit_audit_event` call present in plan pseudocode. foundry.supervisor.degrade_account has evidence_required=true (§B.8) but no emission wired for this path.

tier_blocked.evidence: v4 §B.4 step 11: `Block{..} => RETURN TierBlocked`. No audit emission in plan pseudocode. foundry.supervisor.spawn has evidence_required=true and tier-block is a spawn-refusal — must audit.

quarantine_verdict.evidence: v4 §B.4 pre-mortem (c): quarantine after MAX_PARSE_RETRIES. TickOutcome::Quarantined declared. foundry.supervisor.quarantine evidence_required=true. No emit_audit_event wired in plan pseudocode for this path.

rotate_window.evidence: v4 §B.4 step 9 WindowExpired branch: `self.rotate_window(); recurse once`. foundry.supervisor.rotate_window T2Suggest evidence_required=true. No audit emission declared.

v5_settings_render.evidence: v5 §B.2.2 SettingsRenderer::render writes to ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, ~/.gemini/settings.json. v5 §B.4 CompositeAccountSnapshotProvider wraps render/verify. Zero audit chain emission requirement declared anywhere in v5 delta for render or verify operations. A compliance team cannot answer 'when was account X settings last rendered and by whom' from audit trail.

secret_handling_evidence.openbao_adapter: OpenBaoAdapter: SecretStorePort verified at account-adapter-openbao:26 (in-memory ref impl; 10 unit tests L88-164). Network OpenBao upgrade tracked separately.

secret_handling_evidence.inbox_outbox_no_secrets: v4 §B.2.4 JsonlInbox/JsonlOutbox hand-rolled framing carries message body bytes only; plan explicitly states inbox/outbox never carries raw secrets.
secret_handling_evidence.verdict: SOUND — full secret-reference chain verified across both v4 and v5.

oya-pack-kr.rationale: Plan is silent on whether any ProviderAccount rows in registry/accounts/*.toml represent Korean-regulated tenants. If KR accounts exist, the credential-handling path (sref://openbao/... resolved at spawn) and billing record emission (spend_to_usage_record with tenant_id) should be audited for PIPA-class compliance under oya-pack-kr. The registry/accounts/ directory is a new scaffold artifact (v4 §B.10) — its schema carries no tenant-locale tag to enable pack routing.

oya-pack-eu.rationale: Similar concern if EU-regulated provider accounts exist. GDPR audit-log retention rules would apply to audit_chain entries carrying AccountId + SpendRecord.

regulatory_packs_analysis.overall: No regulatory pack analysis present in v4 or v5. For a pure internal infrastructure plane at current scope (single workspace, no real KR/EU account rows committed), risk is MEDIUM. Must be addressed before multi-tenant or multi-region account onboarding.

evidence: CeilingPolicy::ceiling_for(&TenantId) enforces per-tenant autonomy ceiling — present and composed (v4 §B.0 L97-99).
enforce_for_tenant wired (v4 §B.0 L98); supervisor uses this at tick_once step 11.
spend_to_usage_record carries tenant_id:&str parameter — billing records are tenant-tagged.

RISK: AccountSnapshotProvider::snapshot() returns Vec<ProviderAccount> globally with no tenant filter. In a multi-tenant deployment, RoutePolicy::select (v4 §B.4 step 4) operates over ALL accounts from snapshot(). Cross-tenant account visibility would be a boundary violation. registry/accounts/*.toml schema (new scaffold artifact) has no tenant_id field declared in either plan.

MITIGATION PRESENT: Current scope is single-workspace (all accounts belong to the same operator). The risk materializes only at multi-tenant onboarding, which is not in M02-P06 scope. Must be tracked as open question.

findings.title: New supervisor-kernel types carry no data_class annotation
findings.description: SessionTicket, InboxState, SpendRecord, UsageWindowSnapshot, MessageId, RequestId declared in v4 §B.2.1 have no `/// data_class:` annotation. Account-kernel already establishes this convention (AccountId L14, SessionId L18 both annotated `/// data_class: INTERNAL_ONLY`). SessionTicket wraps AccountId + UsageWindowSnapshot + AutonomyTier — INTERNAL_ONLY at minimum. SpendRecord + UsageRecord bridge to tenant_id — TENANT_SCOPED. Missing annotations break the data-class CI lane and make automated compliance scanning impossible.
findings.remediation: Add `/// data_class: INTERNAL_ONLY` to MessageId, RequestId, SessionTicket, InboxState, UsageWindowSnapshot. Add `/// data_class: TENANT_SCOPED` to SpendRecord (carries tenant_id in spend_to_usage_record). Add to grit unit #8 pre-condition before scaffold.

findings.title: Audit chain emission missing for 4 state-changing verdict paths + all v5 render operations
findings.description: Six capabilities are registered with evidence_required=true (v4 §B.8). C.8 covers spawn/commit. Step 13.5 covers UsageBlocked. But four additional state-mutation paths in tick_once lack declared audit emission: (a) degrade_account on OverUsageLimit/ReserveBreached (step 8-9); (b) TierBlocked (step 11); (c) Quarantine after MAX_PARSE_RETRIES; (d) rotate_window on WindowExpired (step 9). Additionally, v5 SettingsRenderer::render is a credential-adjacent state mutation (rewrites ~/.claude/settings.json with sref-tagged MCP server env) with zero audit chain emission declared anywhere in v5 delta. A compliance team cannot reconstruct 'who caused account X to be degraded' or 'when were account X settings rendered' from the audit chain.
findings.remediation: 1. In tick_once: add emit_audit_event calls at DemoteAndRetry (degrade_account path), TierBlocked, Quarantine, and rotate_window returns — matching the capability_id for each (foundry.supervisor.degrade_account, foundry.supervisor.spawn-refusal, foundry.supervisor.quarantine, foundry.supervisor.rotate_window). 2. Expand C.8 acceptance criterion to enumerate all 6 capability_id audit paths, not just spawn/commit. 3. v5: add emit_audit_event('SettingsRendered', account_id, provider, manifest_hash) to SettingsRenderer::render contract and wire a test in Wave 4d.

findings.title: No regulatory pack impact analysis for per-account credential handling
findings.description: v4 registry/accounts/*.toml (new scaffold artifact) will store per-account subscription credentials (referenced via sref://openbao paths). Neither v4 nor v5 contains any analysis of whether KR (oya-pack-kr / PIPA), EU (oya-pack-eu / GDPR), or US regulatory packs apply to this credential-handling pipeline. The audit-chain entries carrying AccountId + SpendRecord + tenant_id may trigger GDPR audit-log retention obligations for EU tenants. The plan is silent.
findings.remediation: Add open-question to .omc/plans/open-questions.md: 'Regulatory pack scoping for foundry supervisor credential pipeline — analyze oya-pack-kr, oya-pack-eu applicability before multi-region account onboarding'. Gate multi-tenant Wave on this analysis. No blocking action required for M02-P06 single-workspace scope.

findings.title: registry/accounts/*.toml schema lacks tenant_id — AccountSnapshotProvider returns global pool
findings.description: AccountSnapshotProvider::snapshot() returns Vec<ProviderAccount> with no tenant filter (v4 §B.2.3, §B.2.5). RoutePolicy::select operates over the full pool. For current single-workspace scope this is harmless. If registry/accounts/ ever holds rows for multiple tenants (multi-tenant onboarding), cross-tenant account visibility becomes a boundary violation. Schema declared in v4 §B.10 carries no tenant_id field.
findings.remediation: Add `tenant_id = "..."` field to registry/accounts/*.toml schema. Add tenant filter to AccountSnapshotProvider::snapshot() implementation gated on TenantId context. Document single-tenant constraint explicitly in ADR-NNNN-jsonl-best-effort-durability or a new ADR before multi-tenant onboarding. Not a blocker for M02-P06 scope.

findings.title: v5 drift report JSON emitted to .omc/state/ — not declared as internal_only artifact
findings.description: v5 §B.5 CI lane emits DriftReport JSON to .omc/state/settings-drift-report.json. DriftReport.entries may contain target_path values that reveal account-specific filesystem layout and diff strings showing what changed in settings files. This artifact is not gitignored (plan does not declare it as runtime-only) and carries no data_class annotation. If committed, it leaks INTERNAL_ONLY config structure.
findings.remediation: 1. Add .omc/state/settings-drift-report.json to .gitignore. 2. Add `data_class: INTERNAL_ONLY` comment to drift report schema declaration in v5 §B.8. 3. Verify the file is already listed as a non-committed runtime artifact in v5 §B.8 (plan says 'CI report (runtime artifact, not committed)' — enforce this with gitignore rule).

auditability_verdict.when: PARTIAL — same gaps as 'who'; spawn/commit timestamped via EvidenceRef; other paths silent
auditability_verdict.what: PARTIAL — SpendRecord captures what was consumed; DemoteAndRetry.reason and Quarantine.reason exist as struct fields but are not wired to audit emission for those paths

summary: Secret handling is sound and fully verified — SecretReference enforces sref:// scheme, both SecretReference and SecretMaterial Debug-redact, C.29 covers rendered-output secrets, and OpenBaoAdapter is present (10 unit tests verified). Two blockers require remediation before acceptance: (1) data_class annotations missing from all new supervisor-kernel types, breaking the data-class CI lane; (2) audit chain emission wired for only 2 of 6 evidence_required=true capability paths in v4, and zero emission declared for v5 settings-render operations. One medium gap: no regulatory pack impact analysis for the per-account credential pipeline. The plan is otherwise compliant with the SecretReference-only channel discipline, Cedar autonomy ceiling (T1-T4 tier enforcement verified), and the audit chain infrastructure (ADR-0069 gate, replay validation confirmed present in oya-dev-cli).
